name: Toulon

queries.query: Toulon official cadastral parcel map cadastre parcels API
queries.result: Found the official French API Carto cadastre documentation, the official cadastre.gouv.fr parcel-map service, the DGFiP INSPIRE WMS route, and the official Toulon urban-planning page referring users to the cadastral plan.

queries.query: Toulon carte cadastrale officielle parcelles API cadastre
queries.result: Found the same first-party routes in French: API Carto/IGN, cadastre.gouv.fr, and the Toulon city service page. The city page explicitly directs users to download a cadastral plan and identifies the municipal urban-rights service.

officialSources.evidence: Official open REST API documentation describes commune and parcel geometry operations, GeoJSON responses, and WGS84 longitude/latitude output.
Verified GetCapabilities response identifies the Toulon (83137) cadastral WMS, parcel layers, DGFiP operator, and no-conditions access.

officialSources.operator: City of Toulon, Direction du Développement Urbain
officialSources.evidence: Official city page says the service handles urban-rights procedures and directs users to the cadastral plan at cadastre.gouv.fr; this is local custodian/procedure evidence, not a municipal parcel API.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Returned a Toulon commune GeoJSON feature with geometry.

Returned parcel GeoJSON with native fields including gid, numero, feuille, section, code_insee, and idu; response was bounded only in ignored scratch evidence because the unfiltered response is larger.
Exact point [longitude 5.91190474692264, latitude 43.1183148051142] returned zero features. This is a point-query result only and is not evidence of citywide absence.

A smaller polygon around the WUP point returned zero features; a wider 0.004-degree bounded polygon returned five parcel features. Full unchanged responses are in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/toulon/.
DGFiP WMS capabilities retrieved over verified TLS; service identifies cadastral parcel visualization for commune 83137/Toulon. No feature-info request was needed or used.

sourceIdentity.nativeIdField: idu (parcel identity), with API feature id as service identifier
sourceIdentity.compositeKey: idu is a composite cadastral identity containing department, commune, section and parcel number; source fields observed but not retained as sample properties

fieldMapping.gid: source numeric identifier, fallback metadata only

sourceIdentity.crs: EPSG:4326 / WGS84 GeoJSON output; request geometry supplied as longitude,latitude per API contract

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official IGN API Carto cadastral parcels for commune Toulon (INSEE 83137), with DGFiP commune WMS as a corroborating official map service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous API access returned Toulon commune geometry and parcel GeoJSON; bounded wider-area request returned five parcel features. Exact point and smaller polygon were empty.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No exact-point parcel hit; this does not establish absence because cadastral geometry, point-on-boundary behavior, and bounded query semantics can differ.

remainingUncertainty: The public API is confirmed and exposes safe parcel IDs plus geometry, but no retained sample was created, the exact WUP point was empty, and citywide freshness/completeness plus adapter compatibility were not independently qualified.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently verify current API schema, native idu stability, representative citywide coverage, and adapter compatibility before admission.
